home.a: YantranshVT is a strategy, technology and talent company. It helps enterprises turn strategy into execution through four service lines: Data & AI Transformation, Product Engineering, Cloud & Infrastructure, and Talent Solutions. It also builds AI platforms and products, including the VoiceIQ enterprise AI voice agent.
YantranshVT focuses on four industries: Telecom, Banking & Financial Services (BFSI), Healthcare, and Life Sciences. Each has dedicated solutions, such as the AI@Tele framework for telecom operators.
YantranshVT operates across four continents, with locations in New Jersey (USA), London (UK), Bangalore (India) and Singapore.

home.q: What AI and data platforms does YantranshVT offer?
home.a: YantranshVT offers three platforms: the Agentic AI Platform for autonomous problem discovery and root-cause analysis, the Data Modernization Suite for accelerating cloud data migration, and the Predictive Analytics Engine for forecasting operational outcomes and tracking ROI.

VoiceIQ is YantranshVT's enterprise AI voice agent product. It answers customer calls in real time, runs inside the customer's own infrastructure so data stays in-house, and can hand complex conversations to a human agent.

home.q: Which technology partners does YantranshVT work with?
home.a: YantranshVT works across leading technology ecosystems including AWS, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Kubernetes and Docker.
YantranshVT is led by Madhup Sharma (CEO & Founder), Mahanthesh (Director) and Krishan Pal (VP Engineering).
